messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Apigw-eu-west-1 reporting spike in 502/504s (aggregate 12-minute window). Pager routed to @oncall-anna. Graph: https://grafana.redwood.net/d/abc123/apigw-5xx

oncall-anna: paging in. seeing 502s from upstream proxy timeouts. correlation with increased ingress QPS? checking logs.

matt (oncall): i can take initial hotfix. what's the % of failing requests and top routes?

oncall-anna: failing ~18% of requests for /v1/generate and /v1/batch. client fanout from job svc-telemetry spike at 15:40 UTC. sample logs:
```
[2026-03-17T15:41:02Z] apigw:euw: proxy -> upstream: error="recv timeout"
[...snip...]
```

jamie: adding that we saw tcp HALF_CLOSE on some upstreams; connections piling in TIME_WAIT. Could be connection pool exhaustion.

sre-lead: immediate mitigations: 1) enable local 502 circuit-breaker for noisy routes 2) reduce apigw keepalive to 30s on problematic pool 3) route canary traffic to eu-central-2

oncall-anna: rolling config change: set route-level concurrency=50 -> 10 for /v1/batch. applying now. ETA 60s.

matt (oncall): also triggering emergency rate-limit on svc-telemetry client key to 20r/s. support to notify affected customers.

alice-support: posting in #support: "We're investigating elevated errors in EU; temporary throttles applied to some batch endpoints. ETA 30m for stabilization." :loudspeaker:

oncall-anna: change applied, seeing 502 drop from 18% -> 7% in next minute. latency tail still high. continuing.

jamie: found a recent rollout 2h ago that changed nginx proxy_buffer settings and inadvertently increased upstream keepalive backlog. rollback candidate queued.

sre-lead: consent to rollback? +1 from oncall.

oncall-anna: rolling back nginx-proxy-config to previous commit (deploy id: revert-2026-03-17-1022). Monitoring.

incident-bot: DEPLOY: revert-2026-03-17-1022 started by oncall-anna. See CI: https://ci.redwood.net/builds/7890

matt (oncall): after rollback, 502s down to 1.2% and P95 latency normalized. Marking mitigation successful. Preparing postmortem notes.

alice-support: customers averted: one premium tenant saw 5xx errors during 15:40-15:55 UTC. outreach message drafted.

sre-lead: handoff: create incident ticket with timeline + include runbook steps: reduce concurrency, throttle noisy client, rollback proxy-config, enable route circuit-breaker. Assigning to @jamie for RCA.

oncall-anna: thanks team. closing pager and switching to async follow-up. :white_check_mark:
